title: Teachers Toolkit (for client)
details: With this app, students can access simple and easy notes made by their teachers. I have added several options to pick from. check it out. It has an admin panel for managing notes.

title: Decker
details: The Decker app enables you to create various decks, and within each deck, you can add cards. It also has a drag-and-drop functionality and several other features, check it out.

title: Redtomato
details: Redtomato is a food delivery website where you can browse menus and place orders. It uses Razorpay for secure transactions. It has an admin panel for managing data.
